protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED for all advisory mechanisms: checkout/pull used os.Create on an LFS work-tree destination, following terminal symlinks and truncating hard-linked inodes; existing intermediate symlinks were traversed, later MkdirAll also traversed directory symlinks; and in a bare repository the repo-to-current converter could turn a repo-relative name into an escaping path.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: PARTIAL in the primary. e445b45c1c9c6282614f201b62778e4c0688b5c8 is the atomic BIC for the original work-tree write-through-link mechanism, but the separately described bare-repository escape has its own atomic BIC: fd69029c76e3898fc7c81ac2e8705174c4ebf2b5 changed filepath.Join(p.repoDir, filename) to strings.Join via join(); with an empty bare-repo LocalWorkingDir this changes a relative filename into /filename before filepath.Rel.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED for both mechanisms. Parent 685e8771d3ab811a02a8c40216c7b5c34793c7dd only downloads objects and has no os.Create(pointer.Name) or PointerSmudge write-back. Parent e8009e1adebeb7f3633fbf32f48e31fee3859fa1 uses filepath.Join(p.repoDir, filename), so an empty repoDir does not create the leading slash introduced by fd69029c76e3898fc7c81ac2e8705174c4ebf2b5.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED not applicable: e445b45c1c9c6282614f201b62778e4c0688b5c8 and fd69029c76e3898fc7c81ac2e8705174c4ebf2b5 are each single-parent atomic commits, not merge or squash aggregates; later checkout/pull extraction and SmudgeToFile refactors preserve rather than introduce the original write-through-link behavior.
protocol_checks.affected_fixed_release_membership: CONFIRMED. e445b45c1c9c6282614f201b62778e4c0688b5c8 is absent from v0.5.1 and present in v0.5.2; fd69029c76e3898fc7c81ac2e8705174c4ebf2b5 is absent from v2.3.4 and present in v2.4.0, within the published >=0.5.2,<3.7.1 range. Security commits 097751de5b59e68f703ac886a1345ea8d3142f42, 8b4aede153ff6555a7ad96deb2d57c333fdb446d, 5327ac2dca9b50f044b43d73cc2d3a98240df78f, and 2902e9d2dec816f1f7d76b0a6b7177f66a65c374 are in v3.7.1; 8b4aede153ff6555a7ad96deb2d57c333fdb446d is absent from v3.7.0. CVE.org currently records CVE-2025-26625 as PUBLISHED with that affected range.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED with multiple direct fixes: 8b4aede153ff6555a7ad96deb2d57c333fdb446d replaces os.Create with remove plus O_CREATE|O_EXCL for terminal symlink/hard-link collisions; 5327ac2dca9b50f044b43d73cc2d3a98240df78f prevents checkout/pull work-tree writes in bare repositories; 2902e9d2dec816f1f7d76b0a6b7177f66a65c374 adds per-component Lstat directory walking; 097751de5b59e68f703ac886a1345ea8d3142f42 rejects non-regular pointer paths.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: CONFIRMED after adding the omitted BIC. The e445b45c1c9c6282614f201b62778e4c0688b5c8 commit object is authored and committed by rubyist in 2015; fd69029c76e3898fc7c81ac2e8705174c4ebf2b5 is authored and committed by Taylor Blau in 2018. Both objects have one parent, ordinary human identities/messages, and no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Copilot, Cursor, Claude, OpenAI, bot, or Signed-off-by marker. The corrected complete mechanism set therefore still supports NOT_AI.

findings: The primary correctly identifies e445b45c1c9c6282614f201b62778e4c0688b5c8 as the first vulnerable work-tree object write, verifies its immediate parent, release boundary, direct O_EXCL fix, and BIC-only human attribution.

The primary explicitly includes the bare-repository path-join escape in bug_semantics and reasoning but does not identify or attribute its distinct atomic introducer. Exact history identifies fd69029c76e3898fc7c81ac2e8705174c4ebf2b5; its parent uses filepath.Join, and v2.4.0 is the first checked release containing it.
This omission requires a lifecycle/evidence correction but does not change the primary NOT_AI verdict because the omitted BIC is also a marker-free human commit.

corrected_fields.flaw_origin: The original terminal-symlink, hard-link, and existing intermediate-directory-symlink write-through behavior begins at e445b45c1c9c6282614f201b62778e4c0688b5c8, whose parent only downloaded objects. The separately described bare-repository escape begins at fd69029c76e3898fc7c81ac2e8705174c4ebf2b5, which replaced filepath.Join with strings.Join-based join in repoToCurrentPathConverter; with empty LocalWorkingDir this creates a leading-slash path and an escaping filepath.Rel result. Its parent e8009e1adebeb7f3633fbf32f48e31fee3859fa1 lacks that behavior. Both BICs are single-parent, marker-free human commits, so the corrected verdict remains NOT_AI.
corrected_fields.evidence: Add fd69029c76e3898fc7c81ac2e8705174c4ebf2b5 and parent e8009e1adebeb7f3633fbf32f48e31fee3859fa1 as the bare-repository mechanism's introducer/parent pair; record absence from v2.3.4, presence in v2.4.0, BIC object author/committer Taylor Blau, and no AI marker; retain 5327ac2dca9b50f044b43d73cc2d3a98240df78f as that mechanism's direct v3.7.1 fix.
corrected_fields.reasoning: The advisory combines an original unsafe work-tree file creation mechanism with a later bare-repository path-conversion escape. A complete lifecycle must attribute both atomic first writers. The first remains e445b45c1c9c6282614f201b62778e4c0688b5c8; the bare-repository BIC is fd69029c76e3898fc7c81ac2e8705174c4ebf2b5. Since both causal commits predate modern coding assistants and contain no AI marker, NOT_AI is still supported after the correction.
